scope: Exact reviewed display adapters. This is not an exemption for future arbitrary changes.

changes.reason: Visible help text inserted into rendered lines; no binding or parser key changes.
The fragile prefix replacement was moved into a dedicated display adapter; underlying TokenUsage formatting and counts remain unchanged.
The upstream English prefix must remain exactly Token usage:; changing this matching string is a regression.
Known labels in the upstream formatted summary are localized at the output boundary; numeric text is preserved verbatim.
Selection item display name only; typed AppEvent actions are unchanged.
Channel heading and description only; the device object and OpenRealtimeInputChannels event are unchanged.
Display labels now come from the same action catalog; all configuration action IDs and feature gates are separately compared.
Presentation fallback for unknown action names; not parsed or stored as an action ID.
Loading is a noninteractive footer label; the actual tab shortcut is unchanged.
Text in a display-only quota row; the server unlimited flag and credit amounts are unchanged.
Search-only aliases expand underscores to spaces; selected context and action IDs are preserved and exercised by a regression test.
Display-only quota description; used and limit remain in the same order, and percentages and server values are unchanged.
